issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) defines acceptSupplyDelivery with four parameters (supplier name, ingredient name, price, quantity) i.e. acceptSupplyDelivery(String, String, int, int), but both the provided code examples and the solution implementation use a three-parameter signature acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity). This mismatch between the specification and the code will confuse students about the required method signature and can cause compilation or API-compatibility problems when following the examples or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the acceptSupplyDelivery signature consistent across the problem statement, template examples, and solution. Either (A) update the problem statement (UML and textual description) to specify a three-parameter method acceptSupplyDelivery(String ingredientName, int price, int quantity) to match the code and examples, or (B) modify the solution and example Main to implement the four-parameter signature acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity) (and handle or store the supplier name). Align all references (UML, description, example calls, and implementation) to the chosen signature.
